'''Dark trooper team two''' was a unit of [[Dark trooper (stormtrooper)|dark troopers]],<ref name="DE II 2" /> specially trained [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] empowered with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="DE II 3">[[Dark Empire II 3|''Dark Empire II'' 3]]</ref> They were under the command of [[Zasm Katth]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The troopers wore [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]], which was standard for dark troopers.<ref name="DE II 2" />
